name: Atomic Age Theater
description: Black-and-white science fiction from the 1920s to the early 60s: Metropolis, Things to Come, Gojira, Rocketship X-M, Killers from Space, Red Planet Mars, Plan 9 from Outer Space and dozens more flying saucers, giant bugs and mad scientists. The 1936 Flash Gordon serial plays a chapter every Saturday at noon, in order.
curated: 2026-10-14: about 150 hours of hand-listed public-domain sci-fi titles (1965 and earlier) plus the complete 13-chapter Flash Gordon serial; trailers, clips, remakes and colorized versions excluded.

sources.title: Classic sci-fi films (to 1965)
